pkgmetadata.longdescription: OpenHuman is an open-source agent harness from TinyHumans. Ships the `openhuman-core` binary (agent engine, JSON-RPC server) and the `openhuman-tui` terminal client, built from the workspace's default (contributor) feature set: media, skills, flows, mcp, channels, http-server, scheduler-gate, file-logging, modules. First-party submodules (tinyagents, tinybus, tinymemory, tinymcp, ...) are checked out via git submodules and wired in through the workspace's [patch] tables.
